topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I know I should have talked to my neighbor about the fence sooner. We've always had a good relationship, and I didn't want any misunderstandings to come between us. When I saw the posts going in, I should have gone over immediately, but I stalled. Now, it feels like I've missed my chance to have a say in how the boundary is defined between our properties. I can only hope that when I do bring it up, they'll be understanding. Maybe there's still time to chat about aesthetics or the exact line of the fence. I should have been more proactive, but I guess it's never too late to start a conversation, right?
